services.name: Small-Group Swiftie Sunset  BYOB Boat Tour on Lake Travis
services.desc: ARE YOU READY FOR THIS?! Whether you're a dedicated Swiftie or simply someone who appreciates great music, this Taylor Swift Themed Sunset Tour on Lake Travis guarantees an evening brimming with Swiftie magic. Enjoy a cruise that lets you meet new people while taking in the sights along Lake Travis. Our captain serves as a tour guide who may point out landmarks, celebrity homes, or share their own personal stories from the lake. Dressing in theme is highly encouraged for this tour! Feel free to bring your favorite beverages—extra points for those inspired by Taylor Swift—and a camera to seize the magical moments along the way. Lake Travis cruises take off from Float On’s home base at Hurst

services.name: Devil's Cove Party Tickets (per person)
services.desc: Grab your swimsuits, a few beverages, bring your friends, and let's head to Devil’s Cove on Lake Travis! The perfect option for small groups of people looking to get out on the water without having to rent the entire boat themselves. This event is 4 hours long. Grab your tickets for just $99 and prepare yourself for an unforgettable experience. We will be leaving from Hurst Harbor Marina and set sail towards Devil's Cove. We will then drop anchor, tie up our boats, and come together to immerse ourselves in the exciting festivities. We can't wait to see you there!

services.name: Lake Travis Holiday Boat Parade of Lights
services.desc: Crosswater Yacht Club will host a parade on 12/6 Join us for the most anticipated event of the season, the Lake Travis Lighted Boat Parade! Avoid sitting in your car for hours to see the same lights you see every year and head to Lake Travis for a show that will be lit. With contests and bragging rights at stake you’ll be sure to see some incredible looking boats showing off their holiday decorating skills! This small group cruise lets you meet new people while taking in the sights of the Lake Travis in-the-water holiday boat parade. There is not better way to entertain the kiddos, friends or relatives. Perfect for solo travelers or small groups who don’t want to rent an entire boat

A two-time world champion at a young age, she now channels her love for wakesurfing into helping others grow their skills and confidence through personalized lessons. Raleigh shares not only her technical knowledge but also her enthusiasm for the creativity and freedom the sport offers.
